name: ui/address-private-row
title: AddressPrivateRow
summary: One of the owner's private addresses in a list: a lock, the name, the Kweli code in the mono face, who can open it ("Private" or "Link only") in words, and a manage link.

props.name: visibility
props.description: private: no one but the owner; link: whoever holds the share link, never indexed.

props.name: detail
props.description: A line under the code: "Opened 3 times this week".

props.name: href
props.description: Where the owner manages it. No link without it.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: data-visibility names the visibility, the default included.
Who can open the address is written out ("Private", "Link only"); the lock icon is decorative.
The manage link is 44px and its accessible name names the address.

keyboard: Tab to the link; Enter follows it.
focus: The --ring focus ring on the link.
aria: The lock icon is aria-hidden; visibility is text.

theming.brandOverlay: Only --primary (the link) and --ring change with the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The name, code and detail truncate; the link never shrinks.
contract:
contract
  slot is "address-private-row"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/address-private-row"
  when default shows code "NYU-7K2Q"
  a "Manage" min_height 44
  when default shows span "Private"
  when link shows span "Link only"
  when link shows span "Opened 3 times this week"
end

checks.say: The code is in the mono face.
The manage link names the address.
